expected.evidence: invoice exports cut the day in Europe/Berlin time now, because finance closes the books on Berlin days

notes: SYNTHETIC. The hive already has the fact that invoice exports cut the day at midnight UTC (sent as related); the user says that rule is out of date and gives the new one with its reason.
